title: Add lichen_link_channel_select_sync() with GNSS and fallback paths
description: Implement CONFIG_LICHEN_SYNC_HOP guarded lichen_link_channel_select_sync() in link_ctx.c: GNSS-valid path uses lichen_hal_time_snapshot_get() + lichen_sfn_from_unix_ms() + lichen_sync_hop_channel(); !gnss_valid fallback uses pseudorandom hop from EUI64. Files: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/link_ctx.c. ~20 lines in 1 file. Depends on HAL time API existing.
